en.title: Final Fantasy 7 Remake/Rebirth Sales Exceed Expectations Ahead of Revelation
en.summary: The enduring appeal of Final Fantasy 7 Remake and Rebirth is undeniable, with sales figures significantly outperforming projections. Director Naoki Hamaguchi confirms their continued success, even as anticipation builds for the next installment.
en.body:
The **Final Fantasy VII** saga continues its triumphant march, with both **Final Fantasy VII Remake** and its direct sequel, **Final Fantasy VII Rebirth**, achieving remarkable sales success. Even before the electrifying reveal of **Final Fantasy VII Revelation** at Summer Game Fest 2026, these critically acclaimed titles were performing exceptionally well, far exceeding the expectations of Square Enix.

Director **Naoki Hamaguchi** recently confirmed the robust performance of these installments, stating that their sales have been "several times better" than anticipated. This sustained commercial success is a testament to the quality of the games and the enduring love fans have for Cloud Strife and his companions. **Final Fantasy VII Remake** reimagined the iconic Midgar section of the original PlayStation classic with stunning visuals and expanded gameplay, while **Final Fantasy VII Rebirth** continued the journey, taking players beyond the city walls and into a vast, explorable world.

## A Trilogy Built on Solid Ground

The continued strong sales of **Remake** and **Rebirth** provide a crucial confidence boost for the **Final Fantasy VII** project. With **Final Fantasy VII Revelation** officially announced and slated for a Spring 2027 release across all modern platforms, it's clear that the demand for this grand narrative remains incredibly high. This isn't just about nostalgia; it's about a modern interpretation that respects its roots while forging a bold new path. The success of the first two parts ensures that the finale will arrive with substantial momentum and a massive, engaged audience eager to see how the story concludes.

## Fan Excitement Reaches New Heights

For the passionate **Final Fantasy VII** community, this news is nothing short of fantastic. The confirmation that both **Remake** and **Rebirth** are selling so well means the trilogy's conclusion is on solid financial footing and will likely be developed with the full backing of Square Enix. It alleviates any lingering concerns about the project's viability and fuels the already sky-high anticipation for **Revelation**. Fans have been dissecting every detail of the new trailer, speculating about character returns, plot twists, and the ultimate fate of the planet. The journey so far has been epic, and knowing that the developers are seeing such positive reinforcement from sales figures only adds to the collective excitement.

## What's Next for the Compilation

With **Final Fantasy VII Revelation** targeting a Spring 2027 release, fans can expect more details, trailers, and gameplay reveals to emerge throughout the coming year. The focus will undoubtedly shift towards building hype for the final chapter, promising a conclusion that will resonate for years to come.
